evidence.title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
Report: Nvidia to acquire AI model repository Hugging Face for $13 billion

summary: Nvidia is reportedly finalizing a deal to acquire Hugging Face, a leading AI model repository, for approximately $13 billion. The move would significantly expand Nvidia's dominance in the AI ecosystem.
title: Nvidia Nears $13 Billion Acquisition of AI Model Repository Hugging Face
